body: ACCEPTED. The draft ledger now makes network/telemetry posture explicit, including offline enforcement, endpoints/service class, outbound data categories, region, logging, retention, provider training, deletion and credentials. Evidence records now require document identity/version/date, reviewer, and an expiry or recheck trigger. The FFmpeg record separates source-code licence from codec/patent exposure and requires an exact enabled and disabled build surface; it states that LGPL-only is a realized-configuration claim, not a repository label. Both nominated registry rows are explicitly HoldUnknown until complete records pass review; every other family already carries CandidateOnly, Deferred, or OwnerActionRequired plus a reason. Thank you—these are material contract improvements.
